en: An illustrated postcard showing two men, deeply concentrated and somewhat exhausted, playing chess at a small table inside a café. Three interested onlookers gaze through the window behind them. The scene is cartoonish, highlighting eccentric personalities often associated with intellectual Viennese cafés. There is a telephone number written in reverse at the top and a German caption at the bottom.
